about: compiler/lawledger: runners, normalized statement extraction and comparison, ergo.laws ledger & freshness, ergo.cases tapes, killer resolution, and parsed derived laws (SELFHOST-LEDGER-RECEIPT).

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-parse-u64-overflow
mutants.rule: ParseUint64 must reject decimal strings whose final digit overflows uint64 max (...15).

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-same-three-char-op
mutants.rule: Statement tokenization must emit 3-character operators as atomic tokens rather than splitting them.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-freshness-digest-mismatch
mutants.rule: CheckLedgerFreshness must classify entries with mismatched digests as stale.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-cases-prune-orphans
mutants.from:
case option.None:
				(*t).PropDeleted[i] = true
				removed = removed + uint32(1)
mutants.rule: PruneOrphans must mark unreferenced property rows as deleted so ForProperty no longer yields them.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-killer-quoted-match
mutants.rule: LawDeclaredInGo must match double-quoted Go law names without also requiring a backtick literal.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-parsed-where-derived
mutants.rule: collectSourceLaws must derive a refinement law for every type declaration with a where clause.
